# Moving out of 14 Orchard Lane: plan

Completion is on Saturday 21 March. Dana is running the day, and Tom is at work until 3pm.

## The removal firm

- Pell and Sons, a 7.5-tonne lorry and three men. Quote £840, with £200 paid on 2 March.
- They arrive at 8:30 and expect to be loaded by about 3pm.
- Their office number is 01632 960417.

## Parking and access

- The lorry is 8 m long. To reverse onto our drive it needs the whole width of Orchard Lane at the bend by no. 12, so the lane is shut to traffic for about 20 minutes at around 8:30, and again at around 3:30 when it leaves.
- The council has suspended the parking bay outside no. 14 from 7:00 to 17:00 on the day. Cars parked there after 7:00 will be towed, so neighbours need to move them the evening before.
- Pedestrians can pass the whole time. Dana will stand at the bend to wave cars through.

## Packing and inventory

- 62 boxes counted so far, all labelled by room.
- The piano goes last. Two men are needed on the stairs.
- The garden shed contents go in the van too, so the side gate is open from 8:00.

## Utilities and keys

- Broadband moves on 19 March. Energy meters are read on the morning of the day.
- The keys go to the solicitor's office in town by noon, and the buyer collects them there.

## Neighbours

- Work on the house will be noisy from 8:30 to 3:30, mostly the lorry's reversing beeper and the stairs.
- Anyone who needs to get a car out of the lane during the day should call Dana on 07700 900142.
